evidence: Nestled just a few steps away from the picturesque Hoan Kiem Lake, Hang Be Street emerges as a vibrant culinary tableau, encapsulating the essence of Hanoi’s bustling market life right at the heart of the capital city. Historically, this area was once a bustling hub where traders would moor their wooden and bamboo rafts, floating downstream from the northern regions to engage in commerce.
